children.value: > Fact From Story: A new class action lawsuit accuses Google and parent company Alphabet of anticompetitive behavior in violation of U.S. antitrust law.
> > Fact From Story: The suit also specifically cites new AI technologies like Google’s Search Generative Experience (SGE) and Bard AI chatbot as worsening the problem.
> > Fact From Story: The case argues that Google “siphons off” news publishers’ content, their readers and ad revenue through anticompetitive means.

> > > Fact From Story: The case, filed by Arkansas-based publisher Helena World Chronicle, argues that Google “siphons off” news publishers’ content, their readers and ad revenue through anticompetitive means.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge: Siphoning resources from a business reduces their ability to be profitable.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: Lawsuits are often filed when one party believes another party's actions are causing them harm.
> Commonsense Knowledge: An accusation of anticompetitive behavior suggests someone is suspected of violating laws intended to promote fair competition.
